messages:
mira: Heads-up: Hosted API update Cascade-XL + Toolcall v2 GA in us-west-2 today. Docs: https://console.redwood.ai/docs/hosted/toolcall-v2 Please review if you own SDKs, proxies, or support rotations :tada:

henry: Any breaking changes for existing integrations?

mira: Mostly opt-in. v1 will remain available for 60 days. v2 streams typed JSON frames and supports incremental tool deltas and resume tokens. Minimal client changes needed. Example opt-in:
```
POST /v1/generate?toolcall=v2
{ "model":"cascade-xl-1", "stream":true }
```

support: Need a short support playbook and known issues list.

mira: Playbook will be at /docs/internal/toolcall-v2-support. Known gotchas: long-lived connections may hit a 120s idle timeout; very large single-tool payloads (>800KB) should be chunked. We'll notify affected enterprise tenants.

devrel: I'll publish Node/Python samples and a one-page migration cheat-sheet. Planning an internal walkthrough Fri 9am PT.

ops-bot: Canary started: 6% traffic in us-west-2. Monitoring: p95_latency, stream_disconnects, tool_error_rate. Alerts to #eng-runtime.

henry: Marketing blurb for changelog?

mira: Draft: "Cascade-XL + Toolcall v2 GA: incremental tool streaming, resumable streams, and improved latency for interactive apps." Trim as needed.

support: Will prep KB and add banner to Console tomorrow.

mira: Thanks team. I'll post deprecation timeline in #announcements and follow up with targeted emails to big tenants. :rocket:
